user_direction: Guess and test at the W G5 current-authority boundary.

guessed_semantics: An ACTION admits a first-variation operation with respect to a VARIED_ARGUMENT.
A source statement that variation of the ACTION with respect to that argument gives a result is reconstructed as a stationarity consequence of that first variation.
The result remains an opaque source-local condition unless its internal equation semantics are independently qualified.
hypothesis.minimality_guard: The hypothesis does not identify connection, tetrad, frame, torsion-free, Levi-Civita, or Einstein semantics as primitives. Those are source-local role fillers only.
hypothesis.nonclaim: This hypothesis does not derive the named output equations from the action formula on W evidence alone.

adversarial_negative_controls.reason: Conditional multiplicity consequence, not action variation.
Transform output relation, not action variation.

falsification_contract.positive_coverage: All four declared positive occurrences must satisfy the same structural/source-local variation predicate and preserve their exact parent dependencies.
falsification_contract.negative_exclusion: Every other W occurrence whose relation span is give/gives/giving must fail that predicate.
falsification_contract.cross_class_bridge: The same hypothesis must cover both W-G4-Q0023 and W-G4-Q0351 without using source-domain labels as the classifier.
falsification_contract.exact_reconstruction: The hypothesis may reconstruct only the variation-to-result incidence and parent ACTION dependency. It may not invent internal semantics for the result condition.
falsification_contract.overreach_failure: Any negative control matching the predicate, any missing positive, or any requirement to import a source-specific mathematical name falsifies this hypothesis.

g6_gate: A passing W-local test authorizes only creation of a separate G6 candidate qualification project. W may not consume the hypothesis until that module is independently qualified and promoted.
